# About Qurana Academy
Learn Quran online with certified female tutors. 1-on-1 classes for kids & adults. Free trial available across Qatar (Doha, Al Wakrah, Al Khor, Lusail).

## Services and Courses
- [Noorani Qaida](/services/noorani-qaida.html): Learn Arabic alphabets and Quran reading basics.
- [Quran Tafseer](/services/quran-tafseer.html): Deep understanding of Quranic interpretation.
- [Quran Memorization (Hifz)](/services/quran-memorization.html): Structured Hifz program with daily revision.
- [Six Kalima Online](/services/six-kalima.html): Learn the six fundamental Islamic declarations.
